description: Follow an indexed company for future matching openings and company recommendations. Get company_id from Search, a ready submission, or a recommendation candidate_company.id. Specify at least one match; [{}] follows all new openings. This does not submit an unknown careers page or collect historical matches.

filters.description: Alternative matches (OR). Fields inside each match combine with AND. [{}] follows every new opening. This is the complete filter set, not a patch.

companies.description: Exact company names or slugs, not company IDs.

compensation_maximum.description: Maximum listed annual pay amount, not cents. Omit for no maximum. The index does not convert currencies; check compensation.currency in results.

compensation_minimum.description: Minimum listed annual pay amount, not cents. Omit for no minimum. The index does not convert currencies; check compensation.currency in results.

include_unknown.description: Also include openings missing these fields when filtering by them.

locations.description: Location alternatives, supplied as groups. Search matches any listed location.

markets.description: Market slugs, when known. Do not invent slugs.

remote.description: true: remote only; false: on-site or hybrid; omitted/null: any workplace.

terms.description: Role keyword groups: alternatives within a group (OR); every group must match (AND). Example: [["designer", "design"], ["senior"]].

name: following.follow
